name: Toulouse, France

rent.notes: Toulouse houses rent at about 12.70 EUR/m2 (June 2026), so an 80-110 m2 pet-friendly 2-3BR maison runs roughly 1000-1400 EUR; Numbeo (Nov 2026) shows 3BR apartments at 1025 outside centre and 1347 in centre. Taxe d'habitation on primary residences is gone; TEOM is often passed through in charges.

sources.title: Numbeo - Cost of Living in Toulouse

electricity.notes: EDF. Moderate heating. Some A/C use (Toulouse summer highs 86°F).

gas.notes: Engie/GRDF. Natural gas heating (Nov–Mar). Toulouse has moderate winters.

sewage.notes: Included in water bill as assainissement collectif.

utilities.taxes: TVA included in bills: 5.5% on water/assainissement, 20% on electricity/gas.
utilities.notes: EDF Tarif Bleu base 0.2001 EUR/kWh + 15.86 EUR/mo (6 kVA) at ~4500 kWh/yr = ~91/mo; natural gas heating ~8000 kWh/yr at the 0.1042 EUR/kWh prix repere plus subscription = ~85/mo; water + assainissement ~40/mo; trash (TEOM) passed through rent. Numbeo basic utilities for 85 m2 = 195 EUR. Excludes internet.

sources.title: Hello Watt - Prix du kWh electricite et gaz 2026
Numbeo - Cost of Living in Toulouse

healthcare.notes: Legal-resident retirees join PUMA (no premium for pension income; a cotisation subsidiaire can apply if income is mostly capital). Complementary mutuelle for a couple aged ~60 runs about 100 EUR/mo (basic) to 250 EUR/mo (renforcee), ~120-130 typical per Magnolia 2026 tables. Copays moved to medicalOOP.

insurance.notes: Renters (locataire) assurance habitation: LeLynx October 2026 barometer shows 177 EUR/yr for a 70 m2+ apartment tenant (~15/mo); a rented house with contents cover and dog liability sits a little higher, hence ~20/mo typical.

petCare.notes: French vet guides 2026: annual vaccine visit 60-100 EUR, antiparasitaires/vermifuge 100-200 EUR/yr, routine budget 500-1000 EUR/yr for an adult dog (large breeds at the top), plus pet insurance 11-38 EUR/mo. ~75/mo care + ~25/mo insurance for a Bernese.

sources.title: Ymanci - Quel budget par mois pour un chien (juillet 2026)

petDaycare.notes: Keeps the stored model of ~8 sitter/garderie days a month: pension canine or garderie 15-30 EUR/day nationally, Toulouse home pet-sitters list ~15 EUR/hour; 8 x ~30 EUR = ~250/mo. CESU tax credit may offset half of declared in-home sitting.

sources.title: Ymanci - Quel budget par mois pour un chien (juillet 2026)

petGrooming.notes: Professional grooming 40-90 EUR/session for long-coated breeds per 2026 guides; a 100 lb double-coated Bernese sits at the top (~90-110/session). Monthly average assumes a full groom every 6-8 weeks plus de-shedding in between.

sources.title: Ymanci - Quel budget par mois pour un chien (juillet 2026)

transportation.notes: Transit-based as stored: Tisseo monthly pass ~58 EUR (Numbeo Nov 2026; fares rose 1 July 2026, single ticket 1.90), x2 adults = ~116/mo plus occasional taxi/car-share. Tisseo senior reductions start at 65, not 60. Max allows a cheap second-hand car's fuel share (petrol ~1.97 EUR/L).

sources.title: Numbeo - Cost of Living in Toulouse
Le Bonbon - Tickets Tisseo plus chers au 1er juillet 2026

entertainment.notes: Freebox Pop fibre 5 Gb/s 29.99 EUR (39.99 after year 1) or Ultra 8 Gb/s 49.99; streaming ~35; lunch for 2 twice a week at ~15 EUR/head (Numbeo inexpensive meal) = ~240; activities/cinema (12 EUR) ~50.

sources.title: Numbeo - Cost of Living in Toulouse

phoneCell.notes: Two local lines: Free Mobile 5G+ 350 Go at 19.99 EUR each (9.99-15.99 for Freebox subscribers), ~40/mo; plus the stored Google Fi Flexible US-number line at $20/mo base (~19 EUR). Min = 2 discounted Free lines + Fi; max keeps headroom for Fi data.

buffer.notes: Monthly safety buffer for unexpected expenses

medicalOOP.notes: ALD status for hypertension/diabetes provides 100% Sécu coverage on related care. Anti-VEGF injections performed at hospital: 100% covered. Mutuelle covers ticket modérateur and dépassements d'honoraires. OOP mainly for non-remboursé items, some specialist surcharges, and comfort options.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

stateIncomeTax.label: French Income Tax
stateIncomeTax.exemptions: US-France tax treaty. SS taxed only in France.

pros: 4th largest city with lower costs than Paris/Lyon

pros.text: Aerospace hub: Airbus corporate HQ in Toulouse-Blagnac (final assembly for A320/A330/A350)

pros: Pink city charm and vibrant food scene

cons.text: Less English spoken than major tourist cities
Complex French tax situation: US persons remain subject to US tax under the 1994 US-France treaty (saving clause); FBAR/FATCA reporting still required

sources.title: Convention fiscale franco-américaine du 31 août 1994 (with 2004/2009 protocols)

cons.text: Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country
